Thanks — I pulled the service logs for the redeem request id in the attached payload (request_id: r-6f3a2b). Observations: 
- Promo-service accepted the token and emitted an IssuanceRequested event at 2026-05-18T21:03:12Z.
- A downstream consumer was expected to write a grant to the entitlement-ledger; I do not see a successful ledger write for OT-4437. Instead there is a consumer error: "Err: duplicate-key on write to grants (kv conflict)" at 2026-05-18T21:03:15Z and then a retry that returned HTTP 409 from the ledger.

Hypothesis: an idempotency key mismatch caused the issuance to be treated as a duplicate and not idempotent, so the second attempt failed and the flow never resolved to a successful grant. I’ve queued a manual compensating job to create the ledger grant for OT-4437 (50 USD credit) and will push a fix for the idempotency handling in the consumer.

I’ll run the manual grant in 30 minutes and confirm. In the meantime, Olivia — I can also provision a temporary manual grant if you need immediate access for the pilot.
